वक्ता सुखी प्रजावाञ्जितशत्रुर्धार्म्मिको द्वितीयासु।
सम्पूर्णाङ्ग सुभगः शूरः शुचिरर्थवान् पौष्णे।। 14 ।।
One born with Moon in "Uttarabhadrapada" is eloquent in
speech, happy. He has issues and overcomes his enemies. He is
also religious. One born in "Revati" nakshatra has all organs
in healthy condition, has attractive qualities and his personal-
ity is full of valour and is clean and wealthy.
इति श्रीवराहमिहिरकृते बृहज्जातके नक्षत्राध्याय: षोडश: ।।16।।
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter on Traits of Asterisms in
Brihat Jatak composed by Varahamihira.
